statement: Choose the latent and shortcode parameters in the order specified by Equation (5.4), fixing V = K ⊕ W before k. There are a constant γ > 0 and an integer k0 ≥ 8, depending only on these fixed parameters, with the following property. For every cube k ≥ k0 and every parity instance, suppose a function FQ : Hom(LQ, V) −→ K is given for every Q ∈ Qk. Assume folding for every such Q, every P ∈ Hom(LQ, V), and every c ∈ K, and assume sharing for every permitted projection π̄ : LU → LO and every P′ ∈ Hom(LO, V): FQ(P + ce⊤ 0 ) = FQ(P) + c, FU (P′ π̄) = FO(P′ ). (5.6) 24 If this family passes the table test of Equation (4.6) with probability at least 0.99, then the projected advice experiment with β = k−2/3 has local strategies whose probability of full answer agreement is at least γ.
